run.back: a device is paired again with a new token (yardr user device pair ada phone): the old token is not brought back
run.command: yardr user device rm ada phone
run.description: Remove a device: its token is refused from now on, and its streams are closed
does: removes the device phone of ada (added 2 Jan 2006 by pat): its token is refused from now on, the streams it held are closed, and what was queued to tell it is dropped.
What it did stands: the mail it wrote and the asks it approved are not undone.
It is the last device ada has: they have none left.
